tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file as text. DEPRECATED: Use read_text_file instead. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: read_text_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system as text. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: read_media_file
tools.description: Read a file and return it as a base64-encoded content block. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: read_multiple_files
tools.description: Read the contents of multiple files simultaneously. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Make line-based edits to a text file. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a new directory. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: list_directory_with_sizes
tools.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path, including sizes. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: directory_tree
tools.description: Get a recursive tree view of files and directories as a JSON structure. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename files and directories. Both source and destination must be within allowed directories.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Recursively search for files and directories matching a pattern. Only searches within allowed directories.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Retrieve detailed metadata about a file or directory. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: list_allowed_directories
tools.description: Returns the list of directories that this server is allowed to access. Subdirectories within these allowed directories are also accessible.
